candidates.change_summary: Replace withdrawAll implementation to transfer only half the contract balance instead of calling withdraw with full balance.
Change onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (remove the require), so withdrawAll can be called by non-owners and thus change who receives funds.
Replace transfer to send call returning bool and require success, changing failure semantics and gas forwarding behavior.
Remove onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call withdraw, altering who can trigger transfers and thus observable balances after withdraw.
Invert the onlyOwner check to require caller is NOT owner, changing authorization and allowing owner-protected withdrawals to behave differently.
Replace the call to target with a low-level call that ignores the returned bool and does not require success (removes require), allowing sendMoney to succeed even if transfer failed.
Change the call to use transfer instead of low-level call, which will revert on failure and forward 2300 gas.
Modify onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender to be a different (non-owner) address, inverting the check so only non-owners can call protected functions.
